V. 46.
About the ninth hour, Jeſus cried with a loud voice—Our LORD's great Agony probably continued theſe three whole Hours, at the Concluſion of which He thus cried out, while He ſuffered from GOD Himſelf what was unutterable. My God, my God, why baſt thou forſaken me?—Our LORD hereby at once expreſſes his Truſt in GOD, and a moſt diſtreſſing Senſe of his letting looſe the Powers of Darkneſs upon Him, withdrawing the comfortable Diſcoveries of his Preſence, and filling his Soul with a terrible Senſe of the Wrath due to the Sins which He was bearing.
